Asha (Account): Hi team, Ben from Lumen wants a 3-week POC to validate SDK integration, streaming chat UX, auth flows, and quotas. Need scoping + blockers.
Ravi (SE): Proposed POC scope: 1) JS + Python SDK quickstarts, 2) streaming chat demo (SSE), 3) prompt eval set (~12 prompts + rubric), 4) telemetry + request IDs.
Ben (Customer): Requirements: server-side rotating keys, browser short-lived tokens, audit logs for all requests.
Priya (Security): For browser tokens use our STS flow. We'll need completed security questionnaire and confirm retention/encryption policies.
Ravi (SE): SDK notes: Authorization: Bearer <key>. For browser get short-lived token from server endpoint. Example python snippet: `c.chat.create(..., stream=False)`; use `.stream=True` for SSE.
Marta (SRE): Default test quota: 250 req/min, bursts to 600 for short windows. Concurrent streaming connections default 50. If they need sustained >600/min we recommend Dedicated eval.
Ben (Customer): Success criteria: p50 <300ms for interactive queries, streaming start <500ms, >=75% pass rate on eval rubric, logs visible in console. Can we do that in 3 weeks?
Ravi (SE): Yes, if we use a quantized low-latency variant and disable batching for interactive routes. We'll enable KV caching for repeated prompts.
Priya (Security): Action: I'll send SOC2 summary and STS flow docs. Need to confirm data retention window.
Marta (SRE): Load plan: synthetic ramp to 500 req/min for 20min, retries: backoff=200ms, max_backoff=5s, max_retries=4. Use idempotency keys for non-streamed calls.
Asha (Account): Timeline: Week1 auth + SDK hookup; Week2 streaming + telemetry; Week3 load test + evals + wrap.
Ravi (SE): Action items: - Ravi: SDK quickstart + SSE demo (48h) - Marta: provision quota bump and schedule load window (48h) - Priya: send security docs (24h) - Asha: confirm pricing estimate (EOD) - Ben: provide prompt set + rubric by Tues
Ben (Customer): I'll upload prompts and invite Ravi. Thanks.
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC — "POC kickoff: Lumen 10am PT"
Asha (Account): Please flag any enterprise blockers here (legal, compliance, dedicated hardware).
